{{nihongo|'''Izanagi Shrine'''|伊射奈岐神社 (吹田市佐井寺)}} is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945}} in {{ill|Suita|Q653510|qid=Q653510}}, {{ill|Osaka Prefecture|Q122723|qid=Q122723}}. In the section for {{ill|Shimashimo district|Q10976940|qid=Q10976940}} of the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932}}, there are two "Izanagi Shrines," and this is considered one of them. The other is said to be the shrine of the same name in Yamadahigashi enshrining {{ill|Izanami|Q682306|qid=Q682306}}. {{nihongo|'''Izanagi Shrine'''|伊射奈岐神社 (吹田市佐井寺)}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Settsu Province]].

== History ==
According to shrine tradition, during the reign of {{ill|Emperor Yūryaku|Q357235|qid=Q357235}}, Okamoto Toyotarihiko, instructed by imperial princess Yamatohime, a {{ill|Saikū|Q150845|qid=Q150845}} of {{ill|Ise Grand Shrine|Q687168|qid=Q687168}}, sought a place to enshrine five pillars of Kōtaijin and enshrined them in nearby Ogawadani. From the {{ill|Jōgan|Q1075635|qid=Q1075635|lt=Jōgan}} to {{ill|Engi (era)|Q1374325|qid=Q1374325}} era, the other Izanagi Shrine enshrining {{ill|Izanami|Q682306|qid=Q682306}} moved, and to distinguish them this shrine came to be called Oku-no-miya.
